input.text: This is subject to Protocol No 7. The Consumer Credit Act 1998 applies generally. Separately, section 7 of that Act applies.

_note: With a treaty (kind 'treaty') named more recently than the Act in SURFACE position terms is not the issue here -- the Act is the MOST RECENT mention of kind 'act', and 'that Act' must resolve to it, never to the nearer-in-some-other-ordering Protocol of a DIFFERENT kind.
